data.spec: apps/voiceid is a Modal-hosted speaker identification service (WeSpeaker ResNet293-LM ONNX). The backend (apps/agent/office/voice.py) calls it using env vars VOICEID_URL and VOICEID_TOKEN (bearer auth). GET /speakers returns {model, threshold, speakers[]}. Enrollment needs at least 10 seconds of speech per person, with lowercase names matching config/people.json (e.g. leo, noah). Identity is informational only and never grants purchasing authority. Without VOICEID_URL/VOICEID_TOKEN, speaker identification is off.
